entry.summary:
Even smaller earthquakes can be damaging to a home depending on the home’s design, construction and the land it sits on. With all of New Zealand being at risk of earthquakes, know what you should look out for to see if a property might be at greater risk of damage. 

Find out what to look out for at naturalhazards.govt.nz/home-buyers
